objects.name: Analytic 1730
objects.description: For Android, detect Compromise Application Executable from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; Application State via Android Enterprise / EMM [Managed package inventory/status and package metadata]; File Creation via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: APK, DEX, or native library written to app installation path outside MDM-authorized update mechanism — binary replacement is the persistence artifact]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Per-app expected signing certificate and signer lineage. Derive from MDM app deployment records and Play Store signing identity. Any signer change = compromise indicator.

Per-version APK hash (SHA-256 of base APK) from trusted distribution. Derive from MDM app deployment artifacts or Google Play API. FORENSIC: compare extracted /data/app/<pkg>/base.apk hash against baseline.
